hypotheses.label: COMMUNITY_HYPOTHESIS
hypotheses.text: One forum report on firmware 1.1.0: after Klipper was restarted without a full power cycle, the touchscreen went blank during the next print; a full power cycle cleared it

limits: Host clock: the eventtime Klipper stamps on each update (host monotonic clock). Controller clock: toolhead.estimated_print_time (main MCU clock). It resets when the MCU restarts; a Klipper service restart without an MCU reset is not visible.
The 600 s gap is a U1 Doctor display threshold, not an official value.
UNTESTED: this rule has not been checked against a real U1 fault; it only restates the reported values.
missing_data: Whether the touchscreen is responsive, and the time of the last Klipper or firmware restart.
safe_actions: If the touchscreen does not respond, control the print from Fluidd on the local network; power-cycle the printer fully once the print is over.
